PRODUCTION_ARC: THIS IS THE SPINE OF THE PAGE.
2022 launch: 'Produkterna är designade i Sverige och producerade i Portugal' with
materials sourced primarily from ITALY. (Golfbranschen, 19 May 2022.)
2025: Local Rule moves production home. Their own blog, 3 July 2025, bylined
David Zetterlund: first Swedish-made garment is the Performance Shorts, produced
in BORÅS — a city with a long textile heritage. Socks also moved to Sweden.
2026: the Ripstop Headcovers carry 'Made in Sweden' in their own bullet list.
A brand called LOCAL RULE spent three years making the 'local' part literal.
That is the story, and it is entirely sourced.
story.first_collection: 18 garments — polos, windbreakers, vests, trousers — plus bucket hats, caps, tees, towels and golf bags. Original price ladder 50 kr (markers) to 2950 kr (a bag).
story.first_season_aesthetic: Chinos, polos, shorts and caps — described by Golfbranschen as 'en tydlig flört med vintage golf' (a clear flirtation with vintage golf).
story.drop_model: No traditional seasons. Repeated drops through the year, in runs small enough that everything sells and gets worn. (Golfbranschen, 31 May 2023.)
story._drop_model_note: Good editorial detail — it explains why the catalogue is broad but thin per size, and why sold-out colourways sit alongside live ones.

quotes._rule: VERBATIM ONLY. The Swedish quotes below are transcribed exactly. English renderings are LABELLED TRANSLATIONS, not quotes — if a translated line is used on the page it must be presented as a translation, never inside quote marks as if spoken in English.

verified.sv: Vi känner själva att golf är för roligt, för att slösa bort på fula kläder.
verified.en_translation: We feel that golf is too much fun to waste on ugly clothes.
verified._note: STRONGEST LINE. Candidate for the big pull-quote. Names no brand, so it clears the never-talk-down rule — it is aimed at the old status quo, not a competitor. Flagged to Lenny anyway.

verified.sv: Ända sedan vi var små har vi känt att kläderna känns löjliga men inget annat fanns, och inget annat fick bäras.
verified.en_translation: Ever since we were small we have felt that the clothes feel ridiculous, but nothing else existed, and nothing else was allowed to be worn.
verified._note: Runs directly on from the line above in the original. 'Inget annat fick bäras' — nothing else was ALLOWED — is the dress-code point, and it is the reason the brand is called Local Rule.

verified.sv: Efter sju år av att driva eget konsultbolag och kreativt skapande för våra kunder bestämde vi oss för att bygga vårt eget varumärke. Vi har jobbat i drygt ett år med kollektion, varumärke och teknisk plattform och nu känns det fantastiskt att äntligen vara på banan.
verified.en_translation: After seven years of running our own consultancy and making creative work for our clients, we decided to build our own brand. We have worked for a good year on the collection, the brand and the technical platform, and now it feels fantastic to finally be on the course.
verified._note: 'Äntligen vara på banan' — finally being on the course — is a pun that survives translation.

verified.sv: Sedan starten 2022 har vårt mål varit att skapa moderna golfplagg som du stolt kan bära på fairway som i vardagen. Att nu ta steget och öppna vår första butik i Stockholm känns både naturligt och väldigt inspirerande.
verified.en_translation: Since we started in 2022 our goal has been to make modern golf clothing you can wear proudly on the fairway and in everyday life. To now take the step and open our first store in Stockholm feels both natural and very inspiring.

verified.who: Sportfack Gear of the Year jury citation
verified.sv: Märket har momentum, och insikten om att golfvärlden behövde något nytt visar sig i den stora uppmärksamhet de skapat på kort tid.
verified.en_translation: The brand has momentum, and the insight that the golf world needed something new shows in the attention they have created in a short time.
verified._note: Award citation, not an individual. Attribute to the citation.

verified.source: The 45 Best Men's Golf Clothing Brands, 31 July 2025
verified.en: Local Rule loves honoring golf's history while adding a modern twist. They mix traditional cuts with contemporary details, making their collections the perfect blend of old and new.
verified._note: Already in English. The only third-party English-language verbatim line found.
